message: So, there I was, making dinner, and I decided to test the smoke alarm. I thought it’d be a quick check—turns out I was just a little too ambitious with the garlic bread. Smoke filled the kitchen, alarms blared, and my dog looked at me like I was the worst chef ever. Lesson learned: always have a plan for when things go sideways. Maybe next time I’ll stick to microwave popcorn. Do you have a kitchen backup plan?
